notes: Jump! Press Space (controller A) any time in a run to hop — hold it to bunny-hop. It's just for fun: jumping never changes your position, hitbox or damage taken
Phones: turn on the new optional jump button in Audio & Settings; a new "Jump sound" switch toggles the soft hop sound

New class: Eclipse Paragon — "Master of every path". A hybrid of all eight classes that hurls the Eclipse Glaive and channels echoes of every class: Umbral Daggers, Dread Hex, Echo Familiars, Starfall Volley, Penumbra Sweep, Riftstep Mines, Verdant Halo and Solar Cinder, plus the signature Convergence of Eight
The Eclipse Paragon has its own passives, 10 evolutions (see the Codex), three talent trees (Umbra, Wilds, Aether) with new capstones, 5 achievements and 5 armour sets
Unlock the Eclipse Paragon for 3000 Shards from the class select screen or the Armory
Class select: use the up/down arrow keys to choose a class; Enter on a locked class buys it
